title: BLOKS: Scaling Kernel Solvers with Sketched Block Preconditioning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) is a theoretically sound algorithm for nonparametric learning, which is also often used to investigate properties of deep learning. However, the exact KRR formulation incurs time and memory costs preventing applicability to large datasets, motivating the development of approximate solvers. These algorithms rely on (i) iterative methods, to avoid the computational burden of direct solutions; (ii) sketching or batching, to reduce the problem size; and (iii) preconditioning, to accelerate convergence. While crucial for fast convergence, preconditioning incurs memory costs that can be managed by lowering the number of free parameters of the model, potentially at the expense of expressivity and hence accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose BLOKS, a Conjugate Gradient-based solver for Nystr\"om-sketched KRR built around a novel preconditioner that combines a block Jacobi approximation with sketching. translated_title: BLOKS：通过草图化块预条件子扩展核方法求解器
translated_abstract: 核岭回归（KRR）是一种理论上严谨的非参数学习算法，也常被用于研究深度学习的性质。然而，精确的KRR公式会带来高昂的时间和内存成本，使其难以应用于大规模数据集，这推动了近似求解器的发展。这些算法依赖于：（i）迭代方法，以避免直接求解的计算负担；（ii）草图化或批处理技术，以减小问题规模；（iii）预条件技术，以加速收敛。尽管预条件对于快速收敛至关重要，但其带来的内存成本可以通过减少模型的自由参数数量来控制，不过这可能以牺牲模型的表达能力进而牺牲精度为代价。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了BLOKS，这是一种基于共轭梯度法的Nyström草图化KRR求解器，其核心是一种新颖的预条件子，该预条件子将块Jacobi近似与草图化技术相结合。
tldr: BLOKS提出了一种将块Jacobi近似与草图化相结合的新颖预条件子，在加速核岭回归近似求解收敛速度的同时有效控制了内存成本，兼顾了效率与模型表达能力。
en_tdlr: BLOKS introduces a novel preconditioner combining block Jacobi approximation with sketching, accelerating convergence of Nyström-sketched kernel ridge regression solvers while managing memory costs without sacrificing expressivity.
